reviews.review: extremely good, alot of secrets and alot of replayability. fun with friends as well. the amount of secrets in the game are insane.
Dark Souls with guns and a lot of different builds. It's great!

Many call this game the Dark Souls with guns but I never played any Souls game and can't judge.
I actually like chill games because my hardcore gamer days are over. Played the first one with friends on Playstation and I have no freaking idea why I even started playing this solo. My first playthrough was painful. 
Died over and over again but I kept going and still don't know why. Strangely enough, it haven't felt unfair to me. It is really challenging and confusing at first but it becomes really good if you understand the basics. Better gear doesn't mean better chances or an easier playthrough. It's quite the opposite. Understanding and mastering the basics like dodge, spacing, stamina and health managment are the keys to success. 
After suffering the first time and dying probably 1000+ times I kept going and still play the game.
Got all achievements and 100%ed the game. Beat it on every difficulty solo, made Hardcore runs without dying and now just collecting stuff that I miss.

Bosses still are a PITA and many times have these "Magic Pixel" life bar where it is absolutely depleted and just one shot is missing and you die. Happens a little too much for my liking.

If you have the DLC's, you can easily play the campaign several times and will encounter new areas, new bosses and gear etc. 200+ hours in and I haven't even discovered everything.
Late game can become a little dull if you completely armed and geared to take out an entire world, it becomes easy and mundane but you can challenge yourself with a fresh character on highest difficulty.

Where Remnant 2 shines is the Multiplayer. If you have two or more friends (I don't have any friends, which makes me sad) and want to beat it together, it's much more fun, especially if you wipe out the entire team during a Boss battle because you burnt all your mates to crisp through friendly fire and just laugh your bummbumm off. If you don't have someone to play, you can find some in the community and probably Discord.

Not everything is good tho. 

Good things are:

Visuals are good.
Banger Soundtrack
Tremendous replayability.
Finished game (all DLC's already released)
And many more

Bad things:

Frustrating for new players
Hard to find random lobbies
Due to the lack of DRM, players with pirated copies can join your game
If someone is cheating, it can affect you save and maybe corrupt it, losing progress

An absolute downer is the performance. It starts pretty smooth, no hiccups, runs great and so on but as your save file grows (that's my understanding) it get's messy. My FPS dropped from 100 to 60ish with stutters, crashes and so on. I had no upscalers activated nor FG and now I am not able to play without them on balanced while lowering the resolution.

So, is it worth it? When it is discounted, absolutely but stay away from the Deluxe Edition which is pointless as the DLC's aren't included. 4 Bucks more and you get the Ultimate Version.
You can play it for 50 hours casually or 200+ as completionist.
